Priya Menon: Quick sync 1/03: updating the quotas & pricing docs to reflect the new tiered metering + burst-credit semantics. Need: tiny curl + python snippets showing X-Redwood-Metering v2, a fallback example for legacy header, and an iframe for the updated 'Consumption by Tier' panel. Who can take what?
Alex Chen: Ill do code snippets (curl + python requests). Keep them minimal. Will include fallback header example.
Jordan Lee: Dashboard moved. New link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-88. Embed iframe: <iframe src="https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-88" width="100%" height="360"></iframe>
Samir Patel: Copy tweak: change "credits consumed on submit" -> "credits are applied when the request completes successfully". Also add a line that timed-out queued requests release reserved credits.
Priya Menon: Good—use Samir's phrasing. Also add a tiny example showing events and credits_delta (start: reserve, complete: deduct, timeout: release).
Alex Chen: Snippets draft: 

curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Redwood-Metering: {\"client_id\":\"team-17\",\"job_id\":\"j-331\"}" -d '{"model":"rwd/fast","input":"Explain the quota change."}'

# python requests example
import os, requests
headers = {
  "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
  "X-Redwood-Metering": '{"client_id":"team-17","job_id":"j-331"}'
}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", json={"model":"rwd/fast","input":"Explain the quota change."}, headers=headers)
print(resp.json().get('usage'))  # tokens, meter_rate, tier_applied

Fallback header: -H "x-metering-legacy: client=team-17"
Note: when copying the header into some shells, escape quotes or use single-quoted header values.
